# Authenticated billing handoff browser fixture

`python3 packages/tests/fixtures/billing-handoff-browser/run.py` reserves 127.0.0.1:3530/3531, archives the committed checkout into a disposable `/tmp/disposabl-billing-local-*` copy, applies the existing fixture-only billing configuration adapter, installs frozen dependencies, and starts an owned local Convex backend with its beacon disabled. It sets backend `E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` and an empty Boat key before syncing. The existing fixture readiness query rejects configured provider credentials. Only this process's backend is stopped afterward.

The opt-in TesterArmy flow uses the product billing-login page, real handoff handlers and real auth session exchange with a synthetic account. It checks consent, browser identity, single use, expiry and deletion-pending rejection. Payments remain off in the web app; it stops at the product's unavailable pricing page and never calls checkout or a provider. This does not test real payments, native storefronts, production, or a provider sandbox. The fixture adapter's marker and unauthenticated expiry bridge are restricted to the disposable backend copy and must be excluded from starter packages.

The test creates a temporary synthetic user, and browser traces can contain personal or session-related data. Keep them private. The run requires the cached local Convex binary, Bun and installed browser tooling; it does not use a shared browser profile.
